question_templates: I need some light.
I need a bit more light over here.
I could use a little more light here.

lamp: I need a bit more light over here.
I could use a little more light here.

lighting_control.tie_rule: If multiple lighting fixtures remain compatible, keep only rows with one evaluator-distinct embodied goal after residual cue resolution.
lighting_control.notes: Use only pure-navigation supervision toward an operation-supporting lighting proxy. Lamp rows can stay with local-light wording; ceiling fixtures require an external control proxy and should be frozen unless such a proxy is annotated.

question_templates: I want to head out.

I should head through the opening.
exit_transition.tie_rule: If more than one exit is equally compatible and the prompt lacks an explicit disambiguator, reject from C-main-vNext.
exit_transition.notes: Strong embodied semantics; watch multi-exit ambiguity.

question_templates: I want to take care of the plant.
I need to check on the plant.
I want to water the plant.
plant_care.tie_rule: If multiple plants remain compatible and no single residual cue resolves one instance, reject.
plant_care.notes: Keep action-focused wording and reject purely decorative readings.

question_templates: I need to do the laundry.

laundry_cleaning.tie_rule: If appliance type alone does not identify a unique embodied endpoint, require one residual cue; otherwise reject.
laundry_cleaning.notes: Anchored appliance family with relatively clean semantics.

question_templates: I want to look at myself.

self_appearance.tie_rule: If multiple mirrors are compatible, keep only evaluator-unique rows after residual cue resolution.
self_appearance.notes: Very clean semantics but low volume.

question_templates: I want to warm up.

warmth_seek.tie_rule: If more than one radiator remains equally compatible and no single residual cue resolves one, reject.
warmth_seek.notes: Strong implicit intent, anchored target, smaller family.
